countries.definition:
n a politically organized body of people under a single government
n the territory occupied by a nation
n the people who live in a nation or country
n an area outside of cities and towns
n a particular geographical region of indefinite boundary (usually serving some special purpose or distinguished by its people or culture or geography)

countrified.translation: a. 土气的, 粗俗的,思想简单的,质朴的.带有乡村风味的

countrifled.translation: a. 乡下派头的, 乡土气的

countrify.definition:
v. t. To give a rural appearance to; to cause to appear
   rustic.
countrify.translation: vt.使土里土气, 使粗俗, 使有乡村风味

country.definition:
n. the territory occupied by a nation
n. an area outside of cities and towns
country.translation:
n. 国家, 乡村, 地区, 故乡
a. 乡下的, 农村的
[计] DOS外部命令:用于设定国家代码, 包括日期时间及货币格式

country code.translation:
国家代码
[计] 国家代码

country cousin.translation: n. 不习惯城市生活的乡巴佬

country dance.translation: n. 土风舞, 乡村舞, 乡村舞曲

country dancing.translation: n. 乡村舞, 土风舞（为列队舞或圆圈舞）

country note.translation: [法] 地方银行发行的纸币

country of origin.translation:
[化] 原产国
[经] 原产地, 出产地

countryfied.translation: a. 乡野的, 村野的

countryfolk.definition:
n people living in the same country; compatriots
n people raised in or living in a rural environment; rustics

countryman.definition:
n. a man from your own country
n. a man who lives in the country and has country ways
countryman.translation: n. 同胞, 乡下人, 国民

countrymen.definition:
n a man from your own country
n a man who lives in the country and has country ways

countryseat.definition: n. an estate in the country

countrysides.translation: n. 乡下，农村( countryside的名词复数 )

countryward.translation: a. 走向乡村的, 下乡的

countrywide.definition: s. occurring or extending throughout a country or nation

countrywoman.definition:
n. a woman who lives in the country and has country ways
n. a woman from your own country

countrywomen.translation: n. 农妇, 村姑( countrywoman的名词复数 )
